factProposals.value: Every external API call must go through withReliability (explicit timeout, capped exponential-backoff retry) composed with a CircuitBreaker, per REQ-003.

Output is validated against a declared JSON schema (guardrails/outputContractGuardrail.ts) before any persist attempt; a validation failure blocks the persist entirely rather than persisting a warning-flagged record.

decisions.statement: Ported the circuit breaker and timeout/retry pattern from an existing, already-tested implementation (CoreOps's mcp-server/src/reliability/) rather than designing a new one.
decisions.rationale: the pattern was already proven correct there; re-deriving it from scratch would just risk reintroducing bugs already fixed once.

decisions.statement: guardrails/outputContractGuardrail.ts, built two stories earlier with no caller, is now called from persistOutput.ts instead of writing new validation logic.
decisions.rationale: the guardrail already did exactly what REQ-012 asks for; it just needed a caller.

limitations.statement: callExternalApiAndPersist has never been exercised against a real external API - only a mock apiCall function in tests, since no real external integration target exists in this project yet.
"Persisting" is still a logged stub, not a real database write - no persistence layer exists yet.
